description.summary: A bolt of lightning from the sky streaks upon the target of this spell, shocking for 1d6 points of lightning damage per caster level per round (maximum 10d6) and inflicts the Static status effect.
description.value: A bolt of lightning from the sky streaks upon the target of this spell, shocking for 1d6 points of lightning damage per caster level per round (maximum 10d6) and inflicts the Static status effect. A successful Fortitude save reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. If the target fails the initial saving throw, it gets another chance to save every round to end the effect until the duration is ended.
